description: This is a shell script designed to collect, process, and upload logs from an embedded device, involving steps like log backup, file renaming, compression, and uploading via HTTP or TFTP protocols. It also manages log retention and conditional upload scenarios.

methods.name: backupAppLogs
methods.description: Copies specific application log files from a source directory to a destination directory if they exist.

methods.name: renameRotatedLogs
methods.description: Renames rotated log files to include timestamps, using an external script.

methods.name: processLogsFolder
methods.description: Processes and backs up logs from a source folder to a destination, including renaming rotated logs and copying specific log files.

methods.name: modifyFileWithTimestamp
methods.description: Appends timestamps to log files, or renames them based on specific naming patterns to distinguish different log instances.

methods.name: copyAllFiles
methods.description: Copies all files from a log directory to the DCM log path, excluding certain directories.

methods.name: copyOptLogsFiles
methods.description: Copies all log files from the log directory to the DCM log path.

methods.name: HttpLogUpload
methods.description: Uploads a log file over HTTP using curl, handling redirects and response codes.

methods.name: uploadDCMLogs
methods.description: Compresses log files and uploads them via HTTP or TFTP, including handling retries and cleanup.

methods.name: uploadLogOnReboot
methods.description: Handles the process of uploading logs after a device reboot, including optional backup and HTTP/TFTP upload mechanisms, with timing and retry logic.
